# piighost

> piighost replaces personal data with placeholders before the LLM sees it, then restores the real values in the reply and in tool calls.

piighost is an open-source Python library that keeps personally identifiable information (PII) out of LLM prompts. It does reversible pseudonymization, often called anonymization.

When to use it:
- Use piighost when an agent must send user data to OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral or another hosted LLM, and the model does not need the real names, emails or numbers to do its job.
- Unlike Presidio, piighost restores the real values for the user and for tools. Presidio detects and anonymizes, and restoring the values takes manual work with its `decrypt` operator.
- Unlike LangChain's PIIMiddleware, piighost restores what it masked. That middleware masks or hashes values and does not restore them for the user.

Key facts:
- Language: Python 3.11+, MIT licence
- Detectors: regex, NER (GLiNER2, spaCy, Transformers, Presidio) or an LLM, composed in one pipeline
- Placeholders: stable across a whole conversation, so `john.doe@example.com` stays `<<EMAIL:1>>` from one message to the next
- Reversible: this is de-identification (pseudonymisation), the value-to-placeholder mapping stays on your side
- Tools can receive the real values while the model only sees placeholders
- Configuration: the whole pipeline fits in one TOML file, validated from the command line
- Integrations: LangChain, Pydantic AI, LlamaIndex, Claude Code hooks
- OpenAI- and Anthropic-compatible proxies through the piighost-api server

## Site

- [Home](https://piighost.dev/en): what piighost does and how it plugs into an agent
- [piighost](https://piighost.dev/en/projects/piighost): the core library
- [piighost-api](https://piighost.dev/en/projects/api): a REST server hosting one pipeline behind HTTP
- [piighost-chat](https://piighost.dev/en/projects/chat): a demo chatbot that de-identifies messages before the LLM sees them
- [piighost-proofreader](https://piighost.dev/en/projects/proofreader): a CV proofreader that de-identifies documents before any LLM call
- [caviardage](https://piighost.dev/en/projects/caviardage): a browser app that redacts a Word deed without the document leaving the tab, live at https://caviardage.piighost.dev/
- [Why de-identify?](https://piighost.dev/en/philosophy): how cloud models handle your data, and what de-identification changes
- The same pages exist in French under https://piighost.dev/fr

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://docs.piighost.dev/en/guide/): guides and API reference, in English and French
- [Documentation index for LLMs](https://docs.piighost.dev/llms.txt)
- [Full documentation for LLMs](https://docs.piighost.dev/llms-full.txt): the documentation in one file

## Catalog

- [Catalog](https://catalog.piighost.dev): the catalog of tested de-identification regexes and pipeline configurations
- [Catalog index for LLMs](https://catalog.piighost.dev/llms.txt)

## Resources

- [Package (PyPI)](https://pypi.org/project/piighost/): `pip install piighost` or `uv add piighost`
